caption: Soot staining the wall above the fireplace and ground into the cast-stone mantel.
July 24, 2023 — three days after move-in. Soot wiped off the gas logs with one finger; this was the first complaint to Earthcore.
The HVAC contractor holding the home's air filters, blackened by fireplace soot drawn through the system. The HVAC equipment was contaminated and must be replaced.
